newsitem.title: USA: ALPINE SKIING-RAIN WASHES OUT MEN'S WORLD CUP GIANT SLALOM.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-RAIN WASHES OUT MEN'S WORLD CUP GIANT SLALOM.

text.p: Steady rain throughout the night forced the postponement of a men's World Cup giant slalom on Friday, and organisers rescheduled the race for Monday at the end of the four-race Park City programme.
The unseasonable rain began about 9 p.m. Thursday and continued to pepper a race course already softened by warm temperatures and sunshine.
A women's giant slalom was conducted under good conditions on Thursday, won by Sabina Panzanini of Italy.
The revised schedule includes a women's slalom on Saturday and a men's slalom on Sunday, provided the weather cooperates. The forecast is for colder temperatures Friday, with a likelihood of snow.
Race officials were working feverishly Friday to compact the snow and treat it with chemicals to restore the firm surface essential to racing.
